title: Cases for fixed-width increment
statement: For every Boolean word $x$, either $x$ consists entirely of true bits and its fixed-width increment is undefined, or there are a natural number $j$ and a Boolean word $rest$ such that $x$ consists of $j$ true bits followed by false and then $rest$, and its increment consists of $j$ false bits followed by true and then $rest$.
